prompt.alinti: These orb animations are everywhere right now — and somebody just open-sourced them 🔮
It’s called Thinking Orbs: nine dotted orbs, one for each state your product goes through — working, searching, solving, listening, connecting, weaving, composing, breathing, shaping.
Why I keep reaching for them:
→ they replace the generic spinner in any “waiting” state and actually say what’s happening
→ two tuned sizes (64 for chat, 20 for inline text), auto light/dark from your page
→ plain 2D canvas — no WebGL, no filters — so nothing slows a page down
→ respect prefers-reduced-motion out of the box (static frame, still themed)
→ MIT — ship them in a paid product without asking anyone
One npm install, one component, one prop. Comment “ORBS” and I’ll send you the repo + the guide (install, all nine states)
